title: Why Did Crypto Just Crash? (Simple Explanation)
caption: Bitcoin fell about 6% in a day, along with tech stocks. Here is why it happened and what beginners should remember.

scenes.head: CRYPTO JUST DROPPED
scenes.narration: Bitcoin fell about six percent in a day, to near seventy five thousand. Ethereum fell about eight percent.

scenes.head: IT FELL WITH STOCKS
scenes.sub: AI spending doubts and borrowing costs
scenes.narration: It started in stocks. U.S. tech shares sold off, and the Nasdaq had its worst day since twenty twenty.

scenes.head: LEVERAGE MAKES IT WORSE
scenes.narration: When prices fall fast, traders who borrowed get forced out. Over one billion dollars was liquidated, pushing prices lower.

scenes.head: BIG MONEY LEFT TOO
scenes.sub: BITCOIN ETF OUTFLOWS IN ONE DAY
scenes.narration: Bitcoin E T Fs also lost about four hundred thirty million dollars in one day, the biggest outflow this month.

scenes.head: FEAR TOOK OVER
scenes.narration: The crypto fear and greed index fell to twenty eight, down from fifty the day before. That reading means fear.

scenes.head: THREE BASICS
scenes.narration: Drops like this are normal in crypto. Three basics: don't borrow to trade, use only money you can lose, and have a plan.

scenes.head: ONE CRYPTO BASIC A DAY
